Expectation and Covariance
In real life, we often have many RVs interacting at once.
• We’ve seen some simpler cases (e.g., sum of independent Bernoullis).
• Come Friday, we’ll discuss sums of Binomials, Poissons, etc.
• In general, manipulating joint PMFs is difficult.
• Fortunately, you don’t need to model joint RVs completely all the time. 
Instead, we’ll focus next on reporting statistics of multiple RVs:
• Expectation of sums (you’ve seen some of this, more on Friday)
• Covariance: measure of how two random variable vary with each other 
(more next Monday and Wednesday)
